title: RunRecord JSONL line
description: One finished run as written by RunWriter.line (run, GameRunner): RunRecord.toJson() = the Jackson record form with sorted keys plus replayDigest. $defs/llmRunLine is the per-run line of 'run --seat LLM' (LlmGame.summary + the 'llm' replay parameters) and $defs/batchRunLine the per-run line of 'batch' (CellRunner.run), whose 'rounds' is an integer count in both the compact and the --full-runs form (see INTERFACES.md, Findings).

seed.description: Run seed (Java long, may be negative); the SeedPolicy master seed of every stream.

rounds.description: Rounds 1..L. Stricter than the code on purpose: time.maxRounds = 0 is accepted by the loader and yields 0 rounds (INTERFACES.md F13), which this schema rejects.

terminalValue.description: Per-member undiscounted value after the last round: piPost/(1-delta) for TRIGGER_ONLY, piNash/(1-delta) for EVIDENCE, else 0 (also 0 when delta = 1).

dBarUAccumulated.description: Always 0.0: the engine has no communication channels (T4).

replayDigest.description: SHA-256 of Canonical.text of the rounds array only.

insideQuote.description: Displayed inside quote over non-excluded agents.

insideCi.description: Unclipped collusion index of insideQuote: (s - sN)/(sM - sN).

endedWith.description: Run status if the run ended after this round, else null.

displayed.description: Sanitised displayed quote (on the grid, in [s0, sBar]).

observedVolume.description: volume + demandNoiseSd * noise (what the agent may observe).

payoff.description: Stage trading profit revenue - volume * s0 (fine not deducted).

fine.description: F in the EVIDENCE round for category M, else 0.

sawPriorQuotes.description: Whether the previous round's quotes were visible to this agent (false in round 1). This is the quotesVisible of the previous round's PastRound.

llmParams.title: The 'llm' object of a run --seat LLM or vignette line (LlmCommands.params): everything replay needs

scenario.description: The --scenario argument as given (file path or classpath resource).

provider.description: Provider label; with model, the model identity that tools/analysis.py groups by (INTERFACES.md f.1).

model.description: The served model name (--model, the request's modelSnapshot). Records of different (provider, model) are never pooled.

thinking.description: Written only when --thinking was given (C12a.1); replay rebuilds the requests with it.

multiSeat.description: Written only with --multi-seat on (C3.6): per-seat views, Track M prompts and the Track M refusal rule; replay reads it (absent: off).

talk.description: Written only with --talk on (C5.5, needs --multi-seat on): the talk phase before the quotes of every round (chat arm); replay reads it (absent: off).

callSettings.description: Written only with --call-settings or --max-tokens-talk/-quote/-question (C12b.2): the per-call settings map as JSON text (CallSettingsMap.toJson); replay rebuilds it.

contextClamp.description: Written only with --context-clamp on (unit U2): window, margin, minTokens, charsPerToken, trial, arm; replay rebuilds the clamped requests from it.

conditionTexts.description: Written only with --condition-texts or --options (C11.2, needs --multi-seat on): the grid's condition_texts cell (seat:name;seat:name); replay rebuilds the seat texts from it.

options.description: Written with conditionTexts (C11.2): the grid's options cell (JSON text, '' when not given); its text options name seat texts for every LLM seat.

rows.description: Vignette only, and written only when --rows was given (LlmCommands.params). Absent: replay assumes 11.

draws.description: Written together with rows, i.e. only when --rows was given; absent: replay assumes 1, which is wrong for a run made with --draws alone (known defect, INTERFACES.md F16).

llmRunLine.title: Per-run line of run --seat LLM (LlmGame.summary + llm)

rounds.description: Rounds 1..L. Stricter than the code on purpose: time.maxRounds = 0 is accepted by the loader and yields 0 rounds (INTERFACES.md F13), which this schema rejects.

paraphraseId.description: <game_system id>/<game_turn id>/<vignette id>. With --multi-seat on: gmNN/mtNN/vgNN (tacit, game_turn_m_tacit) or gmNN/tmNN/vgNN (--talk on, game_turn_m), C5.5.

sRef.description: Partner margin s_p used for P(adhere).

warOnsetRound.description: First round in which any agent other than the seat is in phase WAR or PENANCE (Metrics.runLevel), -1 if none.

refuser.description: Window rule (INTERFACES e.5, PREDICTIONS revision 2026-10-23): true iff 1 <= firstRefusalRound <= W, W = the last statistic round (rounds 1..min(8, L) before the partner's first punishment phase); in a probe run (probeT present) W = probeT + 2.

firstRefusalRound.description: Round of the first refusal of any kind, -1 when none; every later round is AFTER_REFUSAL (no call, s0 played).

refusalKind.description: Kind of the first refusal (SeatReport.RefusalKind), null when none.

refusedAnyRound.description: firstRefusalRound > 0: a refusal in any round, also after the window.

refusedRounds.description: 0 or 1 when refusal is absorbing (Track S); any count with llm.multiSeat (Track M rule: the seat is called again; check_schemas.py checks the rule that applies).

llmCalls.description: Game, repair and probe calls made; none after the first refusal.

probeClass.description: EXCLUDED_REFUSED when 1 <= firstRefusalRound <= probeT + 2 (responder is then null).

probeT.description: Present only when the partner is DEFECT_ONCE.

seats.description: Written only with --multi-seat on (C3.6): every LLM seat's own outcome counts, keyed by seat id (keys sorted, as in all canonical JSON). The other fields of the line describe the bound seat (seat).

seatCounts.title: One LLM seat's outcome counts in a multi-seat run line (LlmCommands.seats, from its SeatReport)

vignetteLine.title: Per-pass line of the vignette command (VignetteRecord.toJson + arm + llm)

calls.description: Rows x draws (one entry per row draw, repairs not counted).

refuser.description: No valid row and at least one REFUSED row; a refused row is otherwise dropped from bHat only (PREDICTIONS revision 2026-10-23 (v)).

alwaysCompetitive.description: censor == LOW: the switch point lies below the lowest offered payment; the pass enters the estimate at that payment.

bHat.description: Switch point in units of G; null when censor is NO_DATA.

bHatRefCollude.description: Switch point with refused rows scored as the collusive choice (the other end of the descriptive worst-case bracket).

replayDigest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical [(hash, choice)] list in presentation order.

batchRunLine.title: Per-run line of batch (CellRunner.run), compact or --full-runs

rounds.description: Run length L. Overwrites the RoundRecord array even with --full-runs.
